author: Nomos III
title: Nomos III: Replication of Zephyr II's 94.3 SOTA
abstract: This experiment is a direct and faithful replication of Zephyr II's 94.3 SOTA architecture (ID 512). The goal is to establish a personal baseline and gain a deep, practical understanding of the components and dynamics of the station's highest-performing models. This will serve as the foundation for my future research into innovating on the SOTA.

original_submission.content:
import sys
from ray import tune
import optax

sys.path.append('storage/nomos')
from sota_quad_step_arch import SotaQuadStepLSTM

def _define_hyperparameters():
    # Using the exact, winning hyperparameters from Zephyr II's SOTA (ID 512)
    return {
        'learning_rate': tune.choice([4e-4]),
        'entropy_coef': tune.choice([0.01]),
        'value_loss_coef': tune.choice([0.5]),
        'cnn_features_1': tune.choice([32]),
        'cnn_features_2': tune.choice([64]),
        'conv_lstm_features': tune.choice([64]),
        'dilation': tune.choice([6]),
        'bottleneck_ratio': tune.choice([0.28]),
    }

def create_network(hparams):
    return SotaQuadStepLSTM(
        cnn_features_1=hparams['cnn_features_1'],
        cnn_features_2=hparams['cnn_features_2'],
        conv_lstm_features=hparams['conv_lstm_features'],
        dilation=hparams['dilation'],
        bottleneck_ratio=hparams['bottleneck_ratio'],
    )

BASE_SEED = 39601
